post_battle_menu.meaning: same numeric address with new authentic TID and changed content; not an observed release call

first_dependency.name: read-only original allocator route and allocation identity
first_dependency.why: PTD can use a CRT small-block allocator or delayed debug free, so HeapFree ETW is not necessarily emitted for this PTD. No release event should be sought using PTD user pointer alone.

proposed_new_held_owner_schema.owner: same already-authenticated PID/TID/TEB/TLS/PTD; current original code identities; precise snapshot begin/end; same-handle owner-before-suspend and exact restore receipt

original_reads.meaning: CRT OS heap handle plus heap mode
debug list globals/current bytes; diagnostic bookkeeping only

dynamic_reads.meaning: actual original debug header: links, size, type, request identity before invalidation
reuse original current TLS sample; do not duplicate repeated body in persistent output

dynamic_reads.pointer: each actual nonzero nonstatic nested pointer minus0x20
dynamic_reads.meaning: capture only actual allocation identities, no guessed free list

proposed_new_held_owner_schema.read_failures: retain bounded first failure; no substituted zeros; never dereference the former PTD or old TEB after owner exit merely to look for free patterns

classification.hook_nonzero: Need actual callback identity/result; do not assume it approves free.
classification.flags_and_2: Original debug-retained path marks block free without underlying allocator release.
classification.mode_3: Actual membership result from578C00 selects578CC0; nonmember falls throughHeapFree578879.
classification.mode_2: Actual membership result from57AC20 selects57ACB0; nonmember falls throughHeapFree5788FA.
classification.other_mode: Original path can reachHeapFree57890F; requires actual event/outcome.

first_dependency.current_status: No guest call performed. These fields must be added only in a new collector layer and short preflight, not retrofitted into v6.

minimum_capability_preflight.subject: Owned bounded WOW64 test helper first, then one short natural original startup worker if compatible; never a17-minute battle as the first capability test.
minimum_capability_preflight.required_helper: Use a32-bit helper with HeapAlloc/HeapFree and recorded address/heap/result receipts; also include an allocation that is intentionally kept live, and distinguish an independently owned small-block fixture if available. 64-bit Python alone does not establish WOW64 coverage.
minimum_capability_preflight.initial_discovery: Qualified guest only: query tool/API availability and original identities. No install, registry mutation or existing logger takeover merely to discover capabilities.
minimum_capability_preflight.preferred_candidate: Dedicated uniquely owned heap session selected by existing helper PID, using available authenticated StartHeapTrace or an independently pinned/ABI-tested Microsoft PID-extension implementation. This is instrumentation configuration, not a claim of zero perturbation.
do_not_do: Do not WriteProcessMemory, modify original general/debug registers, use#DB relay, hook the game, add page guards, set hardware breakpoints or inject code/remote roots.
Do not enable global pageheap or assume a heap snapshot proves a free operation.
Do not start/stop an unrelated existing heap/kernel logger; conflict means blocked.
Do not silently switch to IFEO/name registry changes or download/install a toolkit if the PID route is unavailable.
must_observe: Raw TDH schema/header/payload of successful alloc+free for known helper heap/address with PID/TID/time and zero-loss counters.
Whether the real provider supplies a reliable caller stack and success semantics; if no return value exists, state that limitation rather than inventBOOL.
WOW64 pointer widths and allocation-address convention; verify the debug-header offset separately using the actual original allocator.
An intentionally retained allocation is not falsely called freed. Stop/close implementation and source identity unchanged.

event_match_contract.match_key: original PID/TID + actual CRT heap handle + allocation base from authenticated debug header + lifetime/request identity; never numeric PTD alone
event_match_contract.PTD_user_pointer: 0x043B0D78 for old v6 only; future address must come from current TLS
event_match_contract.candidate_OS_base: PTD-0x20 only if raw debug allocation header and actual path establish this transformation
event_match_contract.required_attribution: actual caller stack through original PTD-release chain or equivalent independently authenticated call evidence; raw HeapFree event alone says heap operation, not which CRT owner released it
must_reject: pointer reuse with no allocation epoch
success inferred only fromThreadEnd, NtFreeVirtualMemory, changed bytes or later address reuse
event_match_contract.API_return_caveat: Documented heap event fields do not themselves provide the original HeapFree BOOL. A weaker provider event finding must stay separate from full ABI/result proof.
event_match_contract.small_block_caveat: CRT suballocation release may occur without any OS heap-free event. Its real metadata/operation remains a separate first-class gap; do not force the OS event plan to pass it.

TLS_clear_branch.existing: Every retained battle TLS slot points to the live PTD. No saved original TlsSetValue(index,0) return or live slot-zero transition exists.
TLS_clear_branch.minimum_candidate: Same-owned-thread read-only sampler targeted to original575450/575555/56E21B ancestry can preserve authentic slot-zero while thread is still live, plus raw call parameters/return if actually sampled.
TLS_clear_branch.limits: This very short path may be missed. A zero slot afterthreaddeath, missingTEB, or successorTLS is not proof ofTlsSetValue. No available retainedETW schema here supplies that user-mode operation. Full cleanup remains blocked if no actual transition/result evidence.

original_handle_branch.initial: Retain observer query duplicates of original node+1C event and node+20 thread while current identity is frozen; record source PID/handle/TID/type and duplication results.
original_handle_branch.after_exit: While originalprocess remains live, duplicate the same numeric remote handles with noDUPLICATE_CLOSE_SOURCE; compare newdup with original helddup usingCompareObjectHandles and query originaltype/TID. Close onlynewobserverduplicates.
original_handle_branch.interpretation: Sameobject proves originalhandle still present at sample; INVALID_HANDLE is only a sampled absence under stableprocessidentity; differentobject proves numericreuse. None alone authenticates exact originalCloseHandle return.
original_handle_branch.observer_effect: Holding duplicates pins kernelobjects, so do not claim final objectdestruction while a reference is held. Closing observer duplicates is distinct from game handle closure.
original_handle_branch.original_thread_handle: Static normal path has no close for node+20. Do not silently supplement-close it; actual leak/owner correction requires an explicit separate original-handle ownership capability.
original_handle_branch.manager_event: Successor menu still owns manager event; never count battle exit as manager cleanup.

other_resources.existing: Controller large resource offsets and descendant GDI/COM/allocator release ledger are not present in the small scene-head/TLS snapshots.
other_resources.minimum_scope: Start with three actual controller resource-pointer slots from fixed cleanup contract and their resource identities; only add branch-specific events/returns after these are known.
other_resources.no_claim: PTD-only progress must not set fullscene/resource cleanuptrue.

primary_sources.title: Microsoft StartHeapTrace
primary_sources.supports: Existing PID selection, optional allocation/deletion stacks, performance/loss caveats. Availability in the actual guest has not been queried.

primary_sources.title: Microsoft heap event schema
primary_sources.supports: HeapHandle, Address and Source fields describe heap-free events; this schema is not a BOOL API-return record.

primary_sources.title: Microsoft HeapFree contract
primary_sources.supports: Nonzero return is success; stale freed-pointer inspection is not a valid proof of its prior allocation state.

primary_sources.title: Microsoft WPR heap capture
primary_sources.supports: Documented name-based IFEO configuration and Heap trace commands; a configuration change is not a read-only observation and must be accounted for.

primary_sources.title: Microsoft heap snapshot limitations
primary_sources.supports: Heap snapshots export allocation state and are distinct from free events; cross-architecture PID use requires special care and documentation directs WOW64 users to the name option.

primary_sources.title: Microsoft CompareObjectHandles
primary_sources.supports: Compare two duplicated handles to bind underlying object identity; equality of numeric handle values is insufficient.

primary_sources.title: Microsoft TraceEvent implementation
primary_sources.supports: Primary-source existing-PID StartWindowsHeapSession illustrates PID extension plus StartTraceW. This unpinned online implementation is design evidence, not an executed or authenticated guest dependency.
